summary: CE-2 v1.1 Phase 2 UI validation. All 11 previously-skipped acceptance-criterion tests from spec §6 (Tests 17-28 + John fee-exempt + Not-assessed range + participant prefill) now pass end-to-end on live preview URL as trial user (trial30909@example.com). Participant name is correctly prefilled from active participant (Dorothy). Bill scenario returns weekly $88.67 dominant, government share 88.3% / 11.7%, Independence 11.30%, Everyday 26.25%, lifetime cap $137,917.01, Oct-2026 comparison $88.67→$73.19 (saving $15.48/wk = $804.96/yr), 6 source citations with external links. Not-assessed range → ce-range-headline with min $27.91 / max $99.24 and 3 anchor rows (Class 3, 5, 8). cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_ce2_engine.py tests/test_ce2_phase0_gate.py tests/test_cpr1_endpoints.py tests/test_cpr1_ingestion.py tests/test_cpr1_foundation.py tests/test_lf1_iter1.py tests/test_ppc_v2.py tests/test_text_sanitiser.py -q → 207 passed, 11 skipped in 56.66s (matches spec expectation).

critical_code_review_comments: ContributionEstimator.jsx is 871 lines — just above the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting the 8 result sections (PointHeadline / FeeExemptHeadline / RangeHeadline / GovernmentShareBar / RateBreakdown / SafetyNetPanel / OctoberComparison / WhatIfPanel / AlsoWorthKnowing / HowThisWasCalculated) into /components/ce2/result-sections/*.jsx to improve maintainability. Not blocking — the file is well-structured with clear section comments.

In WhatIfPanel line 707 the 'Full Age Pension' scenario cites hard-coded rates (5% / 17.5%). These should ideally be pulled from constants or the engine to stay in sync with any future rate change. Currently correct but a source of drift risk.
The 'Grandfathered' string does not appear anywhere in ContributionEstimator.jsx — confirms the old CE-1 checkbox has been fully removed as spec required.

buildScenarios (line 705) computes yearsToCap only when contribution_annual > 0 — nicely guarded against divide-by-zero. Note that when result.contribution_weekly === 0 (fee-exempt path) the whole WhatIfPanel is short-circuited above via !is_fee_exempt, so this is safe.
Small polish: on the Bill result screen, the '20 days remaining' trial banner from MarketingHeader sits above the tool hero and slightly reduces vertical breathing room; not a bug.

The /api/ce2/constants call in useEffect line 99 swallows the error silently. If it fails the UI still renders (helper text just omits dollar figures). This is acceptable per the spec's 'other_misc_info' note but a Sentry breadcrumb on catch would help diagnose future 502s.

context_for_next_testing_agent: CE-2 v1.1 Phase 2 UI is fully validated and shippable. All 11 acceptance tests from spec §6 pass on the live preview URL. Bill's canonical scenario (part_pension + homeowner=yes + income=$19,029 + assets=$10,000 + post_nov_2025 + defaults) → $88.67/wk, 88.3% govt share, Ind 11.30%, EL 26.25%. John's fee-exempt path (hcp_pre_sep_2024 + hcp_paid_fees=false) → ce-fee-exempt-headline. Not-assessed range → ce-range-min/max with 3 class anchors. All 8 result sections have data-testid attributes matching spec. Participant prefill via useParticipantPrefill works; Dorothy auto-populates ce-person-name. No mocked APIs. LLM tools untouched by this change — the CE-2 calculator is deterministic, no LLM in the flow. Backend regression (207/207) confirms Phase 1 engine + CE-2 Phase 0 gate + CPR1 + LF-1 iter1 + PPC-v2 + text sanitiser all intact.
